title: SchemaCaps: When a Compatible Tool Update Silently Widens an AI Agent's Authority
abstract: arXiv:2611.30750v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The tools users approve for their AI agents keep changing their JSON input schemas. Of 8 surveyed MCP clients and scanners, none is observed or documented to re-approve a tool whose input schema widens (two not determinable). We define non-amplification over the coordinates visible in the schema (declared arguments and undeclared fields, on effective values) and a re-binding rule decided by subschema inclusion, trusting no field labels by default and conservative up to its checker and tested case analysis. Evidence: a Coq proof of composition; 48 regression tests; an exact-reference benchmark, where the reviewed version of the rule silently re-bound 27 amplifying changes, now fixed; and a pilot on 604 releases of 39 public MCP servers. There, 412 of 580 compatible schema changes widen some coordinate, yet compatibility re-binds them silently. The authors' adjudicated double annotation finds at least 76 that add or widen an authority-bear

translated_title: SchemaCaps：当一次兼容的工具更新悄然扩大AI智能体的权限时
translated_abstract: 用户为其AI智能体批准的工具，其JSON输入模式会不断变化。在调查的8个MCP客户端和扫描器中，没有任何一个被观察到或记录到会在工具的输入模式变宽（扩大）时重新批准该工具（其中两个无法确定）。我们定义了在模式可见坐标（声明的参数和未声明的字段，针对有效值）上的“非放大性”，以及由子模式包含关系决定的重新绑定规则，默认不信任任何字段标签，并在其检查器和测试案例分析范围内保持保守。证据包括：组合性质的Coq证明；48个回归测试；一个精确参考基准（其中被评审版本的规则悄然重新绑定了27个放大性变更，现已修复）；以及对39个公共MCP服务器604个版本的试点研究。在试点中，580个兼容的模式变更里有412个扩大了某些坐标，然而兼容性检查却悄然重新绑定了它们。作者判定的双重标注发现至少有76个变更添加或扩大了承载权限的字段。
tldr: 该论文提出SchemaCaps，定义了模式层面的“非放大性”及基于子模式包含的重新绑定规则，揭示现有MCP客户端均不会在工具模式扩大时重新审批，且39个公共MCP服务器604个版本中大多数兼容性变更都在悄然扩大AI智能体的权限。
en_tdlr: SchemaCaps defines schema-level non-amplification and a subschema-inclusion re-binding rule, revealing that no surveyed MCP client re-approves tools when their schemas widen, and that most compatible schema changes across 604 releases of 39 public MCP servers silently widen an AI agent's authority.
